descriptions.notStarted: I heard there's an old butler in the Haunted House. Maybe he needs help cleaning it...
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with Edmunds, Butler of the Prendergast Estate.  It seems that he' run out of #t4000018# to heat the house, which would explain the chill.  I've agreed to help him out and bring back #b60 #t4000018##k so he can refill the fireplaces throughout the house and re-heat the mansion.
descriptions.completed: I brought back #b60 #t4000018##k to Edmunds; he can get the fireplaces going again now.  Hmmm... It seems like there are quite a few fireplaces around this labyrinthine house.
